### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/ui/notification.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/ui/sharing.zod.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/ai/actions-as-tools.mdx`  _(via IApprovalService (symbol, a top-level interface))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/ui/notification.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/ui/sharing.zod.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **139** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 446c8b2a6420a61a2862e6f5140dda71a53316d1` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `81b61a597b8360d84aee075a2397a61e70e78b04` — the merge of head `a766d439f48953f3404f6d3d7afed0cd2617ada1` into base `446c8b2a6420a61a2862e6f5140dda71a53316d1`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 81b61a597b8360d84aee075a2397a61e70e78b04 && git checkout 81b61a597b8360d84aee075a2397a61e70e78b04
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 446c8b2a6420a61a2862e6f5140dda71a53316d1 a766d439f48953f3404f6d3d7afed0cd2617ada1 && git checkout -B drift-repro 446c8b2a6420a61a2862e6f5140dda71a53316d1 && git merge --no-ff a766d439f48953f3404f6d3d7afed0cd2617ada1

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 446c8b2a6420a61a2862e6f5140dda71a53316d1
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 446c8b2a6420a61a2862e6f5140dda71a53316d1` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a766d439f48953f3404f6d3d7afed0cd2617ada1`
Local-runs: none

PR #22511 (stage 31 of #20749, the needles stage): a draft against `main`, head repo equal to base repo, branch `claude/issue-20749-stage-31-needles`, 15 files, +48 / −32, merge base `e148ca984`. Inputs: the card body and all 130 comments (the stage-31 claim `6084058576`, the ACCEPT `6085085283` that amends it, the two newest dev reports `6085042055` and `6085588181`, stage 30's ACCEPT `6074213330` and landing `6074840110`, and stage 20's `5998488373` and stage 21's `6001279159`, which set the needles stage and kept the four hex colours), the PR body and file list, the net diff against `main` at the merge base, and the head's check-runs, read at 2026-10-09T17:19Z. Nothing was built, run, re-run or ablated here: every reading below is `git show` / `git grep` on the fetched head and base refs, or REST.

**Check-runs on the head at this reading:** 42 runs; 38 `success`, 4 `skipped`, 0 failed, 0 queued or in progress. The seven required contexts are green: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check` (with its four lanes `workspace`, `source gates`, `debt ledger`, `consumer gates`), `Test Core` (shards 1/6 to 6/6 and the rollup), `Dogfood Regression Gate` (1/3 to 3/3 and the rollup), `Build Core`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard`. Also green: `Check Changeset` (both runs), `Spec property liveness`, `Build Docs`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Flag docs affected by code changes`, `Part-of PR must not also close its card` (both), `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` (both), both single-writer guards, both same-issue guards, `Auto Label`, `Check PR Size` and `filter`. Skipped by design: `Console Pin Gate` and `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`; `Auto Label` and `Check PR Size` each also carry one skipped re-trigger beside their green run. No run is red. The cancelled-lane red the patch report names sits on the superseded head `fbec38c32`, not on this one.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set: no change — right.** Read on the diff: 0 schema lines, 0 `.describe()` strings, 0 keys, 0 defaults, 0 exports and 0 types move. Every changed non-test line is inside a `/** */` or `//` comment: `ai/build-progress.zod.ts` (8 lines), `contracts/approval-service.ts` (1), `ui/notification.zod.ts` (3), `ui/sharing.zod.ts` (2); the rest of the diff is seven test files, two generated pages and one changeset. `Type Check · source gates` and `Spec property liveness` are green on the head.
- **Public surface: shipped text moves and nothing else — right.** `packages/spec/package.json` at the head ships `src/**/*.zod.ts`, so the three `.zod.ts` comment edits ship as source; `approval-service.ts` is not a `.zod.ts`, but its interface docblock is emitted into `dist/contracts/*.d.ts`. The two reference pages regenerate from the module docblocks, and `check:docs` (inside the green `TypeScript Type Check`) holds them equal to what `gen:docs` produces. That is why a changeset is owed (②).
- **Meaning: every shipped text keeps what it says and only loses the id — right.** Each changed line was read in its context at the head:
  - `build-progress.zod.ts` lines 8, 27, 77, 84, 108, 123, 177: `cloud#2172` becomes "the cloud build-progress card"; line 85: `objectui#7388 block 2` becomes "block 2 of the objectui build-panel card". Every sentence keeps its verb and object — ruled the vocabulary in, owns WHERE in the loop a frame is emitted, the two carriers of the liveness watch, the emitter has not landed, owns the hop base. One reading nit, not a change: line 177 now reads "the cloud build-progress card owns and this card does not decide", two cards in one clause; it still parses to the same statement.
  - `approval-service.ts:999`: "exactly as #16495 declared `IAutomationService.cancelRun` / `restoreConsumedSuspension`" becomes "exactly as the automation-service contract declared …". The subject moves from the card that declared the two verbs to the contract that carries them; what the sentence tells a later author — copy that sibling's declaration form — is unchanged, and `#15389` and decision batch `#106` on the same lines stay.
  - `notification.zod.ts:48` and `:103`, `sharing.zod.ts:24` and `:114`: `#5015` becomes "no-door retirement". The bodies the labels head say "had **no authoring door anywhere**" (notification, line 52) and "`EmbedConfigSchema` no door at all" (sharing, line 11), and "ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, ruled REMOVE" stays on the next line, so the words name the decision the id stood for.
  - `notification.zod.ts:94`: `[#4610]` becomes `[dual-source removal]`. The note's own first sentence says "dual-source cleanup, #4535 C3", and the correction block below it still names `#4610` as the evidence it corrects, so the label describes the removal and the retirement's standing does not move.
  - `content/docs/references/ai/build-progress.mdx`: four body lines mirror the docblock; the front-matter `description` grows "(the cloud build-progress card, ruling A)" because `packages/spec/scripts/lib/page-description.ts` drops only citation-only parentheticals, so a parenthetical with words now stays. Deterministic generator output, confirmed by the green `check:docs`; noted in ③. `ui/sharing.mdx:27` mirrors `sharing.zod.ts:24`.
  - Test strings: the two titles lose `(#22110)` and already state the decision (a flow text slot reads double-brace holes and refuses a single-brace token); the pin's `ruling` value and the `why:` ledger value keep their record ids (`5979239990`, `6070963704`) and lose only the card number.
- **Needles: same strength, and no place left matching the old text — right, measured on both refs.** "Places" are the lines inside the exact text each test reads where the needle matches.

  | pair | reader (verified in the test at the head) | old needle, places at base | new needle, places at head |
  |:--|:--|:--|:--|
  | P1 | `build-progress.zod.ts`, whole file (`SOURCE`) | `cloud#2172`: 8, 27, 77, 84, 108, 123, 177 | "the cloud build-progress card": 8, 27, 77, 84, 108, 123, 177 |
  | P2 | the same | `objectui#7388 block 2`: 85 | "block 2 of the objectui build-panel card": 85 |
  | P3 | `approval-service.ts`, the docblock slice above `continueRestoredRun?(` | `#16495`: 999 (the hit at 1083 is outside the slice at both refs) | "the automation-service contract": 999 |
  | P4 | `ui/notification.zod.ts`, `indexOf` plus the anti-vacuity regex at `:134` | `// [#4610]`: 94 | `// [dual-source removal]`: 94 |
  | P5 | `ui/notification.zod.ts` and `ui/sharing.zod.ts`, each whole | `#5015`: 48, 103 and 24, 114 | "no-door retirement": 48, 103 and 24, 114 |
  | P6 | the pin test's own `ruling` value at `:322`, matched by the regex at `:417` | `#21704`: the one value | "the five members the last typing stage stopped on": the one value |

  - Each new needle has 0 hits at the base anywhere under `packages/spec/src` and `content/docs`, so none pre-existed to match vacuously. Each old needle has 0 hits at the head in its reader: `cloud#2172`, `objectui#7388 block 2`, `[#4610]` in `ui/notification.zod.ts` and `#5015` in both `ui/` modules are gone; `#16495` remains in `approval-service.ts` only at `:1083`, outside the slice at base and head alike; `[#4610]` remains only in the `./system` twin, which no test reads by that label.
  - `scripts/` and `scripts/adr-anchors/` name none of the old needles and none of the four reader files, so no gate read the old text.
  - The "every place moves" rule was applied consistently: `cloud#2172` matched bare, so all seven occurrences were places; `objectui#7388 block 2` matched only at 85, so the two other `objectui#7388` mentions (`:78`, `:107`) are citations, not places, and rightly stay.
- **Scope held — right.** The 15 files are the claim's ten, the two class (e) titles, the amendment's `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts:497`, `ui/sharing.mdx` (follows `sharing.zod.ts:24` through `gen:docs` alone; `check:docs` would red without it) and the changeset. 0 governed paths; 80 changed lines; first line `Part of #20749` with no closing keyword (both Part-of guards green). The three class (e) strings have no reader: a `git grep -F` of each old title and of the `why:` value's opening words at the head finds only the literal itself. With them gone, the only ids left in the `packages/spec/src` test strings are the four CSS hex colours stage 21's ACCEPT kept, which is the end state stages 20, 21 and 30 set for the card.
- **Residual ids beside the moved text, read on purpose:** `objectui#7388` (`:78`, `:107`), `cloud#1838`, `#15389`, `#106`, `#4535`, `#5781`, `#4610` (`:106`), `#4583`, `#3950` are comment citations no test matches. The card body partitions code comments to #20234, so they are not this stage's share; raised once in ③.

### ② Semver level

- One changeset, `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, with `Clause-②: no` at a line start in both the changeset and the PR body — **right.** The diff publishes: three shipped `.zod.ts` sources and a `.d.ts` docblock change, so `skip-changeset` would be wrong (that label is for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package). Nothing authorable, exported or typed is added, removed or renamed, so `patch` is the level, neither `(widening)` nor `(narrowing)` applies, and no ADR-0087 disposition marker is owed. The changeset body carries no tracker number, names the four shipped texts and tells a consumer that matched the old words which new words to match. `Check Changeset` is green on both of its runs.
- Clause-②: no — upheld. No published surface grew or shrank.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions`: the stage report declared one (the regrown `why:` ledger value at `:497`, outside the original claim). **Answered A** by the ACCEPT `6085085283`, which amended the claim with that file, and executed as `a766d439f`: one span on one line, `#22211 A` becomes `letter A`, the ruling record `6070963704` stays, and no assertion reads the text — confirmed on the head. The patch report declares none.

`deviations`, stage report, each answered:

1. Reader places beyond the claim's "about" lines, inside admitted files (`build-progress.zod.ts` 77, 84, 108, 123, 177; `sharing.zod.ts` 114) — **required, not merely accepted**: leaving any would have left the old id standing at a place the old needle matched, so the new needle would match fewer places than the old one. Confirmed by the places table.
2. Two regex readers moved in lockstep (`notification.test.ts:134`, the pin at `:417`) — confirmed; both sit in claimed test files, and `:417` is the reader stage 20's and stage 30's rulings named.
3. The `build-progress` page description keeps the words — confirmed from `page-description.ts`. Observation for the next edit of that docblock, not owed here: the lead parenthetical now ends the search snippet; stating the provenance in a second sentence would keep the snippet on the subject.
4. Base-side mutation legs on the one worktree, detached at the base; 5. the null P2 leg re-anchored before its run; 6. a refused `bash -c` loop re-run as literal commands; 7. stage 30's scratch caches overwritten (read caches, not evidence any record cites); 9. the stage instruments living in scratch, not the repo; 10. the cleanup order — process notes, not review matters.
8. Model-free commit trailers and the session-URL PR footer — confirmed on the PR body; neither the PR body nor the changeset carries a model identifier.

`deviations`, patch report, each answered:

1. The STALE TREE note (branch behind `origin/main`, gates derived on the branch tree) — accepted: the check-runs on this head ran on the merge ref and are the gate verdicts; `main` has moved further since, which the queue's rebuilt generation re-verifies.
2. A separate scratch directory; 3. the four observations unchanged; 4. trailers; 5. cleanup — not review matters.

`out_of_scope_findings` (four, all noted in the PR's Acceptance notes and none filed), each answered:

- Class (e) regrowth between stages — agreed, an observation about the denominator; the census at this head reads only the four kept colours, and nothing in this diff changes what arrives later.
- The `build-progress` liveness docblock's "zero readers" and carrier sentence may be stale after objectui's chat-panel change — agreed that it is documentation drift and that this stage was right to replace the id and leave the claim. **Escalated to the seat, one line:** the docblock's carrier sentence is a claim in shipped text with no named carrier; whether a docs-drift card is owed is the seat's call at close-out. Not a ground against this PR, which neither adds nor removes the claim.
- Comment citations with live ids in the four reader files — agreed, comments are #20234's share by the card body's partition. **Escalated to the seat, one line:** the dev report records #20234 as closed, so those residual ids now have no named carrier; the seat decides whether a successor card is owed. Not this PR's.
- The two-digit `PD #12` / `batch #58` labels — agreed, below the census id pattern and unchanged by this diff.

Not a flag, noted for the landing seat: the PR is a draft (ready first, arm second), and the ACCEPT orders the card to close when this stage lands, since its end state is then reached.
